analysis: The PR changes one documentation line in docs/provider/cli-reference.md (head lines 296-297). It states that `darkbloom switch` scans local models in the daemon's resolved config's `model_cache_directory`. This is documentation only. No code, authorization, attestation, encryption, billing or routing behavior changes. The base unit is a later excerpt of the same file, and the head unit starts at line 1; neither contains security-relevant behavior beyond what the patch shows. I saw no contradiction with the threat model. Model weight location touches A-004 and T-012/T-027 (operator-controlled weights, hash verification). The surrounding text still says the provider validates artifacts and hashes before fencing admissions and that tracked models need pinned catalog hashes, so the weight-integrity mitigations are unchanged. The cache-storage text (T-041) is untouched. Remaining question for later passes: whether the actual `switch` implementation honors `model_cache_directory` consistently with the daemon's startup scan and hash validation. That code is outside the supplied evidence, so I record it as an unverified contract rather than a finding.
